title: Multi-class Hierarchical Question Classification for Multiple Choice Science Exams
answer_short: The dataset was collected by annotating 7,787 science exam questions with detailed classification labels from a fine-grained hierarchical taxonomy of 406 problem domains, using a two-stage annotation process with two annotators and resolving disagreements manually.
answer_rationale: The dataset was constructed by annotating science exam questions with detailed classification labels from a fine-grained taxonomy. The annotation process involved two annotators working independently in stage 1, followed by manual resolution of disagreements in stage 2 to ensure high-quality classification.
